author: Rebecca (Look With New Eyes)
citation: Venturing along the North Norfolk Coast Path, I weighed up the options and settled on a sheltered spot of long grass just on the edge of the footpath overlooking Holkham beach, with the soft long grass acting as a mattress. Snug in my bivvy, I drifted in and out of sleep, watching the horizon line change colour.
location: Long grass edge of North Norfolk Coast Path overlooking Holkham Beach, near Wells-next-the-Sea, Norfolk, UK
provenance: Personal blog post by Rebecca of Look With New Eyes, dated 25 March 2017, recounting her first solo microadventure overnight bivvy in the long grass near Holkham Beach.

author: Kent Survival (Andy)
citation: I found a spot just behind the camera where here I found this little area which I'm quite liking. It's very bumpy and rocky, but I've only got a bivvie bag, so I think it'll fit on a spot just behind the camera there. Sure is nice to uh get out for another coastal camp before the summer's up.
location: Coastal cliffs overlooking the sea on the Jurassic Coast, Dorset, UK (near White Nothe / Ringstead area)
provenance: YouTube video by Kent Survival channel, published 1 September 2021, describing an overnight wild camp in a bivvy bag on the rocky coastal cliffs overlooking the sea.

author: EastAnglianBushcraft (Craig)
citation: This week, you join me as i solo wild camp in the woods above the beach, with views over the North Sea on the East coast of England. I set up my new tent in the Sycamore trees which was a perfect fit for a night of relaxing and drinking a few ales.
location: Sycamore trees / woods above the beach on the Suffolk Coast Path, East coast of England, UK (near North Sea)
provenance: YouTube video by EastAnglianBushcraft, published 27 September 2023, of solo wild camping in the trees just above the beach with views over the North Sea.
